verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing natural-language features. Copilot works inside Microsoft apps like Word, Excel and PowerPoint, Paint Cocreator turns text prompts into art, and Windows AI APIs exist for Copilot+ PCs. None of these documents controlling Windows itself (settings, files, apps) through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: a documented OS-level natural-language assistant for operating Windows, coverage of system actions and settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
